rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese word for both the small spoon and the measurement unit.

example.english: A teaspoon of salt is enough.
example.jyutping: lok6 jat1 caa4 ci4 jim4 zau6 gau3 laa3

rows.note: Use this less common term specifically for the physical small spoon, not normally for the measurement unit.

example.english: Please use a teaspoon to stir the sugar in the cup.
example.traditional: 請用茶羹攪勻杯中嘅糖。
example.jyutping: cing2 jung6 caa4 gang1 gaau2 wan4 bui1 zung1 ge3 tong4
